brief:
The Freedom Flotilla Coalition announced a new international maritime effort to break Israel's blockade of Gaza, with ships sailing from European ports, according to Middle East Eye. The coalition said governments have failed to address the humanitarian situation in Gaza and pledged to confront the blockade through direct action at sea.

The announcement marks a resumption of the coalition's activism following previous attempts to deliver aid and challenge Israeli restrictions on Gaza's maritime access. The flotilla has historically sought to draw international attention to conditions in Gaza and pressure authorities to lift the longstanding blockade.
